title: GET /health contract
description: Single source of truth for the backend health-check endpoint contract (path, method, success status code, response body shape). Both backend and frontend contract tests must read this file directly (not copy its values into hard-coded literals) so the contract cannot silently drift between the two sides.

responseBody.description: JSON Schema fragment for the successful (200 OK) response body. Reused as-is for real jsonschema validation on the backend, and mirrored by an equivalent field/type check on the frontend.
